counterhypotheses.claim: Qwen projected features are poorly calibrated for user-specific instance/layout familiarity; a dedicated lightweight embedding encoder is Pareto-superior despite duplicate vision work.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Same fixtures/seeds/resources; compare raw Qwen, tiny projection, dedicated embedder on open-set calibration + total path latency/RAM/VRAM.

counterhypotheses.claim: Coarse spatial pooling removes the small-text/local semantic cues that distinguish visually similar GUI states.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Near-neighbor UI, small OCR, same-layout-different-content and shifted-layout held-out sets.

counterhypotheses.claim: Cropping/temporal compression hides globally relevant static context often enough that full-frame processing is safer and equal or better under Frank's actual task distribution.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Modal-outside-ROI, hidden operation, slow drift, background state-transition and action-verification fixtures.

counterhypotheses.claim: Pre-decode associative memory priming amplifies false familiarity and confirmation bias; simpler post-decode direct retrieval is safer and equally efficient.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Wrong-high-confidence seed, shuffled seed/topology, stale layout, changed identity, no-EAP and direct-memory controls.

counterhypotheses.claim: Runtime cache/media-state limitations create too much hidden divergence for safe replay; the only robust policy is always re-encode visual evidence after restart.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Restart/replay equivalence and stale-state rejection with/without retained compact media descriptors.
